opening.argument: The presentation promotes OneCoin as “an innovative, safe and real cryptocurrency” and directs viewers toward purchasing investment packages through a registration link. It presents highly specific projected returns: a €1,000 investment is associated with minimum income of €50,000 after three years, while €5,000 is associated with €250,000, alongside a stated six-month return of money. It further describes a partnership and extensive bonus structure, including direct-sales, network, matching, startup, club life, gold, and leadership bonuses. By combining these concrete appreciation claims with active enrollment messaging, urgency, and encouragement to participate, the presentation drives viewers toward purchasing tokens and joining the earning program.

citations.quote: So there is a new opportunity. OneCoin is an innovative, safe and real cryptocurrency.

The company has a partnership program and look further how you can earn with this business. Bonus plan. Company has bonuses. Bonus direct sales, bonus network, matchin-bonus, startup bonus, bonus club life, bonus gold, and program leadership.
